surface: the result screen, the first time it is ever reached, after the first cleared ticket of the run
intent: WIDENED from the current draft. Neural Strain is the run's shared health bar across every ticket and does not regenerate on its own; hitting zero ends the run. It drops from two different things on a win: rotations past par, AND any enemy trap that actually sprung on the player, even if they stayed under par. A clean, trap-free dive at or under par costs nothing.
constraints: 2 lines max, 160 chars each, no em or en dashes, terminal voice, second person. Do not imply strain only drops from extra rotations; traps sprung against the player also chip it, independent of par. This is a correction from the previous draft, which named only the rotation cause.
title: NEURAL STRAIN
lines: Strain is shared across every ticket today and will not recover between them. Zero ends the run.
It bills you for rotations past par, and separately for any of their traps that actually sprung on you.
